title: Object Storage
description: Connect an S3-compatible bucket so cloud models receive images and videos by URL instead of inline data. Works with Tencent COS, Alibaba OSS, and any S3-compatible service.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Bucket location and identity. Credentials are stored separately in the local secrets database.
connection.publicBaseUrlDescription: Optional public bucket domain or CDN that serves the uploaded objects.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Leave a field blank to keep the saved value.

actions.saveFailed: Could not save object storage settings
actions.removeFailed: Could not remove object storage configuration
actions.loadFailed: Could not read object storage settings

removeConfirm.title: Remove object storage?
removeConfirm.description: The bucket configuration and its saved credentials will be deleted from this device.
